newsitem.title: USA: SEC makes effective Laser Master shares.
newsitem.headline: SEC makes effective Laser Master shares.

text.p: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission has declared effective a registration statement for 4.5 million common shares filed by Laser Master International Inc, the company said Sunday.
Laser Master provides computerised design, pre-press and flexographic printing services and products for the packaging, apparel and home furnishing markets.
It has also offered environmentally safe, water-based printing processes and developed precision laser technology for use in commercial and industrial applications.
